//: Copy to appsettings.work.json and fill in. That file is gitignored; this one is the shape.
//keys: Every key below except Mailgun is required - the API and worker refuse to start without them.

Mailgun.//: Optional. Leave empty to run without outbound email; both hosts log a warning at boot.

Hosting.//ClientSecret: Bearer key for POST /api/problems. Generate 32 random bytes, base64.

Api.//AllowedOrigins: Required: the committed default is empty, and an empty list applies no CORS policy at all.

Apps.//: Bearer keys for /api/apps/**. One per client; rotate by appending, then removing.
